title: Protest in Uzice supporting mother seeking investigation into daughter death
seoTitle: Uzice protest for investigation into death

tea.why: Parents seeking truth and accountability regarding the 2023 death of their pregnant daughter in the Užice hospital.
tea.want: A new independent medical expert review and accountability for evidence manipulation.
tea.changed: Nov 15: The mother ended her nine-day hunger strike as supporters gathered outside the prosecutor office.

summary: A protest gathering took place outside the prosecutor's office in Užice in support of a mother who ended a nine-day hunger strike. According to news reports, the mother and her husband have spent over three years seeking answers regarding the 2023 death of their 25-year-old daughter at the Užice hospital during the sixth month of her pregnancy. Responding to a student call, citizens assembled at the location to show solidarity. During the gathering, the mother questioned conflicting official causes of death, discrepancies in state medical expert reports, and the disappearance and reappearance of key autopsy evidence. Demonstrators demanded a new, independent expert review, accountability for evidence manipulation, and action from the prosecution.
demands: Conduct a new independent medical expert review
Require the prosecutor's office to perform its duties
response: No official response reported in the sources.

deaths.text: The protest concerns the 2023 death of a 25-year-old pregnant woman at the Užice hospital.

updates.text: A support gathering was held outside the prosecutor's office in Užice following a nine-day hunger strike.
